description: The duplicate-key abend of 2900-WRITE-TRANSACTION-FILE :562-579, and the only case in this folder that proves the two writes performed BEFORE it are not taken back. WHY '22' IS FATAL HERE, AND THE ASYMMETRY THAT MAKES IT SO. :34-38 declares TRANSACT-FILE ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED, ACCESS MODE IS RANDOM, RECORD KEY IS FD-TRANS-ID, FILE STATUS IS TRANFILE-STATUS, so WRITE FD-TRANFILE-REC FROM TRAN-RECORD at :564 is a keyed add under the sixteen bytes of TRAN-ID, and a key already present reports the duplicate status '22' instead of storing anything. The ladder then runs statement by statement. :563 MOVE 8 TO APPL-RESULT establishes the assumed failure every I/O paragraph in this program starts from. :566 tests TRANFILE-STATUS = '00' AND NOTHING ELSE, so the ELSE at :568 takes :569 MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT rather than :567 MOVE 0. :571 tests 88 APPL-AOK, declared VALUE 0 at :143 over APPL-RESULT PIC S9(9) COMP at :142; APPL-RESULT holds 12, so the condition is FALSE, :572 CONTINUE is skipped and the ELSE at :573 runs its four statements in order: :574 DISPLAY 'ERROR WRITING TO TRANSACTION FILE', :575 MOVE TRANFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS, :576 PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, :577 PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM. Now the contrast that makes this case necessary: 2700-UPDATE-TCATBAL guards its READ at :481 with IF TCATBALF-STATUS = '00' OR '23', so a missing category-balance key is tolerated and routed to the create arm. That tolerance is local to :481 and belongs to a READ. It is NOT the rule at :564. Every other status test in this program - :512 on the category-balance WRITE, :530 on its REWRITE, :566 on the master WRITE, the six opens and the six closes - enumerates '00' alone, and the program contains no duplicate arm anywhere. Generalising :481's two-status tolerance to the master write is the single easiest way to get this paragraph wrong, and it would turn an abending run into a clean one. THE COLLISION IS SEEDED, NOT INJECTED, WHICH MAKES THIS THE MOST FAITHFUL OF THE FOUR ABEND CASES. CBTRN02CParityTest runs case18 under Scenario.CLEAN: no repository outcome is forced anywhere, unlike case14 (REJECT_WRITE_FAILS) and case17 (REJECT_OPEN_FAILS), whose refusals are properties of a backend that no arrangement of records can express. Here TRANFILE is seeded with one 350-byte CVTRA05Y row whose TRAN-ID is the sixteen bytes 0000000000683580 - byte-identical to the DALYTRAN-ID of dailytran row 0 - and the keyed probe the master repository issues before it inserts finds that row and answers '22' on its own. It is also the realistic cause of the condition: POSTTRAN re-run over a daily file whose transactions the master already holds. The seeded row therefore carries dailytran row 0's own field values with exactly ONE deliberate difference: TRAN-PROC-TS is 2022-07-18-22.01.02.000000, the stamp an earlier run would have composed, not the 2022-07-19-23.12.34.000000 this run composes. That one field is load-bearing - see WHAT SURVIVES below. THE STATUS LINE, CHARACTER BY CHARACTER. IO-STATUS is a group of two PIC X items, IO-STAT1 and IO-STAT2 at :132-133, and IO-STATUS-04 at :138-140 is IO-STATUS-0401 PIC 9 followed by IO-STATUS-0403 PIC 999 - so the rendered image is exactly FOUR characters wide and can never be more. 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS :714-727 has two arms and '22' takes the second. :715 IF IO-STATUS NOT NUMERIC is false, because both characters are digits; :716 OR IO-STAT1 = '9' is false, because IO-STAT1 is '2'; so the ELSE at :722 runs :723 MOVE '0000' TO IO-STATUS-04 and :724 MOVE IO-STATUS TO IO-STATUS-04(3:2), overlaying the two status characters onto positions three and four of the four-character image and leaving positions one and two as the zeros just moved, giving 0022. :725 DISPLAY 'FILE STATUS IS: NNNN' IO-STATUS-04 concatenates the twenty-character literal and the four-character field with NOTHING between them, so the line is FILE STATUS IS: NNNN0022 - positions 1-20 the literal, 21-24 the image, and no space at the join. The trailing NNNN belongs to the COBOL literal and is not a placeholder awaiting substitution. case17 reaches the OTHER arm, :717-721, with a permanent-error status and renders NNNN9000; the two cases together drive both arms of the one paragraph. THE ABEND. 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM :707-711 displays 'ABENDING PROGRAM' at :708, moves 0 to TIMING at :709 and 999 to ABCODE at :710 - both PIC S9(9) BINARY at :147-148 - and calls CEE3ABD at :711. APPL-RESULT is 12 at that moment and the call does not return. WHAT SURVIVES, WHICH IS THE POINT OF THE CASE. 2000-POST-TRANSACTION performs its three sub-paragraphs unconditionally and in one fixed order at :440-442: 2700-UPDATE-TCATBAL, then 2800-UPDATE-ACCOUNT-REC, then 2900-WRITE-TRANSACTION-FILE. The first two therefore complete before the third is attempted. 2700 reads key 00000000007010001, which tcatbal.txt row 6 holds, so TCATBALF-STATUS is '00', WS-CREATE-TRANCAT-REC stays 'N' at :473, the DISPLAY at :476-477 is not emitted, and :495-499 routes to 2700-B-UPDATE-TCATBAL-REC, whose :527 ADD DALYTRAN-AMT TO TRAN-CAT-BAL and :528 REWRITE store 0.00 + 504.77 = 504.77. 2800-UPDATE-ACCOUNT-REC then runs :547 ADD DALYTRAN-AMT TO ACCT-CURR-BAL for 193.00 + 504.77 = 697.77, finds DALYTRAN-AMT >= 0 at :548 and so runs :549 ADD DALYTRAN-AMT TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT for 0.00 + 504.77 = 504.77 rather than :551's debit branch, leaving ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT at 0.00, and rewrites at :554. Only then does :564 collide. THE COBOL PERFORMS NO ROLLBACK, AND NONE MAY BE ADDED. There is no ROLLBACK verb, no SYNCPOINT, no unit of work around :440-442 and no compensating logic anywhere in the program; every dataset POSTTRAN opens is defined RECOVERY(NONE) in app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD. A write is durable the moment it completes and CALL 'CEE3ABD' does not take it back. So the category balance stands at 504.77 and the account at 697.77 with cycle credit 504.77, while the transaction master still holds only its seed. That partial, internally inconsistent state is the expectation of this case, preserved deliberately under practice B5: it is behaviour, not a defect to be protected against. THIS CASE IS THE DETECTOR FOR AN UNWANTED TRANSACTIONAL ROLLBACK. Spring Batch's default chunk transactionality would undo both earlier writes when the exception propagated, and TCATBALF would read back 0.00 with ACCTFILE at 193.00 and cycle credit 0.00 - the seeded values. If those three numbers appear instead of 504.77, 697.77 and 504.77, the diagnosis is not an arithmetic error: it is that the implementation wrapped the posting sequence in a rolled-back transaction, which is a behaviour change rather than a fix. It is equally the order proof. Reversing any two of the three PERFORMs at :440-442 would leave every other case in this folder passing and only this one failing. WHAT THE ABEND PREVENTS, EXHAUSTIVELY. :564 sits inside the PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y' loop at :202-219, so everything after END-PERFORM is unreached: the six closes 9000-DALYTRAN-CLOSE :221, 9100-TRANFILE-CLOSE :222, 9200-XREFFILE-CLOSE :223, 9300-DALYREJS-CLOSE :224, 9400-ACCTFILE-CLOSE :225 and 9500-TCATBALF-CLOSE :226; both count lines, DISPLAY 'TRANSACTIONS PROCESSED :' WS-TRANSACTION-COUNT at :227 and DISPLAY 'TRANSACTIONS REJECTED  :' WS-REJECT-COUNT at :228; the IF WS-REJECT-COUNT > 0 / MOVE 4 TO RETURN-CODE / END-IF at :229-231; DISPLAY 'END OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBTRN02C' at :232; and GOBACK at :234. The next iteration of the loop is never entered either, though on this single-record seed there would have been none. The four-entry message list is therefore the assertion rather than an abbreviation of a longer one: the only line emitted before the ladder is the opening banner at :194, because all six opens and every step of the validation and posting sequence up to :564 succeed silently. There is no 'TCATBAL record not found for key : ' line, because the key existed and :476-477 lives on the INVALID KEY path alone. A TRAN-PROC-TS WAS COMPUTED AND NEVER PERSISTED. :437 PERFORM Z-GET-DB2-FORMAT-TIMESTAMP and :438 MOVE DB2-FORMAT-TS TO TRAN-PROC-TS run BEFORE 2700, so this run does compose a stamp even though no row is ever written with it. Z-GET-DB2-FORMAT-TIMESTAMP :692-705 builds DB2-FORMAT-TS PIC X(26) from FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE in the shape declared by the REDEFINES at :160-175, and the clock is pinned rather than read: ParityHarness.DEFAULT_PINNED_CLOCK fixes the instant at 2022-07-19T23:12:34 UTC - the analysed revision's own stamp, Ver CardDemo_v1.0-15-g27d6c6f-68 Date 2022-07-19 - whose zero nanosecond makes DB2-MIL 00, giving exactly 2022-07-19-23.12.34.000000 (practice B7). That value reaches the TRAN-RECORD area in WORKING-STORAGE and dies there. The proof is in the final state: TRANFILE's one row still carries 2022-07-18-22.01.02.000000, the earlier run's stamp it was seeded with, so the case asserts not merely that no row was ADDED but that the existing row was not OVERWRITTEN. THE RETURN CODE AND WHERE 12 COMES FROM. CBTRN02C executes no MOVE ... TO RETURN-CODE on any abend path; its single such statement is the literal 4 at :230, which sits downstream of END-PERFORM and is unreachable here. The value asserted is the one the abend itself carries: the translation raises common.AbendException through the job's shared failure tail, which passes the current APPL-RESULT as the RETURN-CODE - 12, AbendException.RETURN_CODE_IO_ERROR, the value :569 moved - alongside ABCODE 999 and TIMING 0 from :710 and :709. Twelve sits inside the domain this model permits, 0, 3, 4, 8, 12 and 16, and satisfies gate G35, which requires the abend to carry the code the COBOL held. Note what it displaces: on this seed a completed run rejects nothing and would have ended at 0. WHAT EVERY DATASET HOLDS AFTERWARDS. DALYREJS is declared at zero rows on the WRITES channel at its 430-byte width from app/jcl/POSTTRAN.jcl:34-36, and expectedWrites is empty as a positive statement that nothing was rejected rather than an absence of interest: this transaction PASSED all four stages of 1500-VALIDATE-TRAN and then failed to write, so :214-215 was never reached. DISP=(NEW,CATLG,DELETE) at :34 names DELETE as the abnormal disposition, so an abended step leaves no reject generation behind in any case. All five relations are pinned on the final-state channel, each field by field AND as a whole record image whose length proves the total width - DALYTRAN 350, XREFFILE 50, ACCTFILE 300, TCATBALF 50, TRANFILE 350 (gates G19, G21). DALYTRAN and XREFFILE come back exactly as seeded, which the program must leave undisturbed; DALYTRAN-PROC-TS is 26 spaces on input and :437-438 copies into TRAN-PROC-TS, never back into the daily record. TRANFILE holds exactly one row, its seed, at rowIndex 0. THE WIDTHS AND THE FILLER SPANS, DERIVED. CVTRA05Y declares FOURTEEN spans, not fifteen: 16 + 2 + 4 + 10 + 100 + 11 + 9 + 50 + 50 + 10 + 16 + 26 + 26 + 20 = 350, the last of them FILLER PIC X(20). TRAN-RECORD is a WORKING-STORAGE item and its trailing FILLER is not one of the twelve receivers at :425-436, so those twenty reserved bytes are spaces both in the row this case seeds and in the record :564 attempted. CVACT01Y is 300 with FILLER PIC X(178); CVTRA01Y is 50 with FILLER PIC X(22); CVACT03Y is 50 with FILLER PIC X(14). Omitting any of them would leave a record short by exactly that span, which is why the image is pinned beside the fields. TCATBALF'S FILLER STAYS THE FIXTURE'S TWENTY-TWO ZERO CHARACTERS, AND THAT IS THE SOURCE SPEAKING. 2700-B-UPDATE-TCATBAL-REC :526-542 does exactly two things, ADD and REWRITE, and issues no INITIALIZE; the record area still holds what READ INTO put there at :474, so the 22 reserved bytes are rewritten unchanged. INITIALIZE appears only on the create arm, 2700-A-CREATE-TCATBAL-REC at :504, which is why the sibling case02 - a key absent from tcatbal.txt - expects 22 spaces there instead. This case takes the rewrite arm, so it expects zeros, exactly as case01 does on the identical path. Reading '22 spaces' onto this arm would be reading the create arm's INITIALIZE onto a paragraph that has none. ENCODING AND NUMERIC POLICY. Every row here is US-ASCII, named explicitly and never taken from a platform default (practice B8). The overpunch convention in these fixtures is positive final digit 0-9 as { A B C D E F G H I and negative as } J K L M N O P Q R, so 0000005047G is +504.77 in an eleven-byte PIC S9(09)V99 span and 00000001930{ is 193.00 in a twelve-byte PIC S9(10)V99 span. The keyword ROUNDED appears ZERO times in this program - indeed zero times in all 28 - so every store truncates: scale exactly 2 with RoundingMode.DOWN, never HALF_UP and never HALF_EVEN. Re-derive by hand: 0.00 + 504.77 = 504.77 stored as 0000005047G; 193.00 + 504.77 = 697.77 stored as 00000006977G; 0.00 + 504.77 = 504.77 stored as 00000005047G; the debit stays 00000000000{. The misspelled ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE is carried under its source name from app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy: renaming it to ACCT-EXPIRATION-DATE would leave the field-for-field diff looking for a field the decoder never produces. The cross-reference rows are still 36 bytes on disk as cardxref.txt ships them (gate G16) and the CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50 normalisation supplies CVACT03Y's trailing FILLER X(14) once, at seed time, before anything decodes the row; nothing is padded at comparison time. app/jcl/POSTTRAN.jcl:23 is EXEC PGM=CBTRN02C with no PARM=, so there are no job parameters. PROVENANCE AND STANDARDS. Every expected value here is STATICALLY DERIVED, by structured reading of app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl against the byte layouts of app/cpy/CVTRA06Y.cpy, CVTRA05Y.cpy, CVACT03Y.cpy, CVACT01Y.cpy and CVTRA01Y.cpy, the DD and DCB contracts of app/jcl/POSTTRAN.jcl, and the real rows of app/data/ASCII. It is NOT captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy program, because executing it is empirically impossible in this environment - no z/OS or CICS runtime exists, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler disabled, no Language Environment CEE* services are present, and the IBM-supplied DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR copybooks are absent from the repository. Only the provenance of the expected values is substituted; the 20 cases per program, the field-for-field diffing and the diff-count-equals-zero gate all stand. Because that modifies a stated success criterion it is escalated for explicit user confirmation rather than absorbed (AAP 0.7.6, risk R-A). review_rules reports that NO USER RULES WERE PROVIDED for this project, so their absence is stated rather than filled with invented rules, and the case is held instead to the AAP 0.10.2 enterprise practices: B1 no placeholders, the colliding row a complete 350-byte record with every span populated; B3 the legacy sources and app/data are read-only and the seeded rows are byte-exact copies, the colliding row existing only in this file; B5 the partial post preserved exactly rather than tidied into a consistent state; B7 the clock pinned rather than read; B8 explicit field-name-to-value pairs beside the record images, the code page named, the scale and rounding mode named; B11 the status image, the arithmetic and every span width derived above so a reviewer can re-check them against the copybooks by hand; and B12 this paragraph.
